idsControlTenant.description: The tenant that the IDS control tag lives in.

idsControlTag.description:
IMPORTANT: This is always prod.
The tag that the IDS control lives in.

idsControlCanonicalUrl.description: The canonical url of the cluster that the IDS control tag lives in.

idsC3euserId.description: The id of the IDS control tag's c3euser.

idsC3euserPass.description: The password of the IDS control tag's c3euser.

idsC3euserEmail.description: The email of the IDS control tag's c3euser.

controlVanityUrl.description: The {@link VanityUrl} to be used for the IDS control tag

idsOrgName.description: The desired {@link PlatformOrganization} name to be used for the IDS control tag

idsPmUserId.description: The desired id of the {@link User} that will represent the IDS control tag in Marketplace

idsDesiredVanityUrlDomain.description:
The domain that IDS should use when creating VanityUrls. If this is not supplied,
it will fallback on the domain of {@link #controlVanityUrl}.

useMarketplace.description: Whether or not artifacts should be obtained through Marketplace packages

useJenkins.description: Whether or not the IDS control tag should trigger builds through C3's Jenkins Apps Pipeline

jenkinsInstance.description: The Jenkins instance that should be used to run builds for the IDS control tag

jenkinsAuth.description: The authorization to use when triggering builds for {@link #jenkinsUrl}

idsCloudStorageBuildArtifactFsScheme.description: What type of cloud storage file system the IDS control tag uses to store build artifacts.

idsCloudStorageBuildArtifactMount.description: The {@link FileSystem} mount that should be used to store build artifacts

usePresignedUrlInRemoteDeployments.description: Whether or not to use pre-signed urls when deploying using deployment pipelines

twilioSid.description:
Twilio account configuration.
See https://www.twilio.com/docs/sms/api/message-resource#create-a-message-resource for more info.

criticalFunctions.description: What setup steps should cause an error to be thrown rather than returned in the final {@link IdsSetupResult}
